items.title: Scholt Energy nets €475M private credit loan
items.summary: Incumbent lender Ares Management is leading a roughly €475 million private credit loan to Scholt Energy to refinance debt and fund a dividend, according to market sources. Bridgepoint is also part of the lending club. The financing was marketed off an EBITDA of around €100 million, the sources said. Ares and Bridgepoint declined to comment.
